lucid-flyway.description: Added operational visibility and a support recovery path. Provisioning now records audit events, monitors setup completion, and opens a support ticket when onboarding stalls so the customer success team can intervene.
lucid-flyway.topology-changes: C^audit[Record provisioning audit event] C^monitor[Monitor setup completion] C^stalled{Setup stalled?} C^support[Open support ticket] C^cs[Customer success follows up] C^audit --> event C^ready --> monitor C^monitor --> stalled C^stalled -->|No| complete[Onboarding complete] C^stalled -->|Yes| support C^support --> cs C^cs --> monitor U^flags --> event^flags --> audit
